coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Venue
record.summary: Venue is a 147-149 unit apartment building at 1155 4th St, managed by Sares Regis Management; DataSF Assessor records and a RentCafe listing both give 2014 as the building's construction-completion year.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8711025), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 255652150) for the name and street address; not a hand trace or plan estimate. The real, notable Edwin M. Lee Apartments (124,000 sq ft supportive-housing building for veterans and low-income families, 1150 3rd St, one block away) was investigated for this pass but its address point sits ~37m from this footprint's edge -- close enough to be the nearest available DataSF footprint, but not confidently its own separate outline in the building-footprint data checked. Left out rather than guessed; a future pass should re-check with a dedicated satellite/plan comparison.

images.caption: USDA NAIP aerial orthophoto (2024 flight), cropped to the Mission Bay project area and its immediate surroundings
images.appeal_note: A straight-down orthophoto rather than an oblique aerial, but Oracle Park and Chase Center are both clearly recognizable landmarks in the frame, giving anyone who knows the city an immediate fix on the neighborhood.

images.caption: Aerial view of Mission Bay, Oracle Park and the Caltrain/King Street area from a departing flight
images.appeal_note: Oracle Park's diamond and Chase Center's dome (with its own logo) are both clearly identifiable landmarks in one colorful frame -- reads far better at card size than the flatter government orthophoto.

open_questions: Some apartment-listing aggregator summaries give 2015 rather than 2014 for this building's construction year; DataSF Assessor records and RentCafe's own 'Building constructed in 2014' listing text were preferred and used here. Precise month of completion is not sourced.
Developer/architect not confirmed from any source checked in this pass.
